name: dag-gate
description: The person's side of the /dag skill: /dag-approve writes a digest-bound approval the dag.py runner accepts (only when the person types it), /dag-pending, /dag-revoke, /dag-stop, /dag-resume; and a guard that denies the model's writes into .dag folders, edits to the frozen dag skill and this mod, and dag.py approve or resume (Bash, Write, Edit, subagents too).
